name: the Parco del Valentino
title: Ancient Trees in Turin's Parco del Valentino: 5 to Find
meta_description: Turin's oldest tree is an oak behind the castle here, and the city's tallest tree is a plane by the fountain. Five remarkable trees along the Po.
intro: Turin's oldest tree and Turin's tallest tree both stand in this park, a few hundred metres apart along the Po. The oldest is an oak behind the Castello del Valentino, past two hundred years by the regional register and the exception in a city where every other tree that old is a plane. The tallest is a plane by the Fontana dei Dodici Mesi at forty metres, and nothing in Turin beats it. A third plane, six metres round, is the widest trunk in the park, and a hackberry stands alone on open grass, which is why its crown is so even.
